trends.name: Agent payments move into the product execution layer
trends.summary: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, and Google connects Google Wallet to Gemini. Agents are beginning to gain user-approved payment capabilities.
trends.attention_driver: Payment tokens, approvals, and spending actions are becoming competitive entry points for general-purpose agent products.

evidence.quote: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases
evidence.claim: Supports OpenAI introducing approved purchasing capabilities for agents within ChatGPT.

evidence.quote: OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet
evidence.claim: Supports ChatGPT Wallet being positioned as a rebuilt agent shopping solution.

evidence.quote: Connect Google Wallet to Gemini for personal finance insights
evidence.claim: Supports Google connecting Wallet data to Gemini for personal finance scenarios.

evidence.quote: You can now ask Replit Agent to buy stuff for your business, including buying ads to acquire new customers!
evidence.claim: Supports the expansion of product experiments in which agents execute commercial procurement and ad purchases.

trends.so_what: Agents involving purchases, ad placements, or billing should treat per-transaction approval, spending limits, revocable records, and failure fallback as launch capabilities. Payment execution will shift how the value of subscription assistants is measured toward attributable transaction outcomes.

trends.name: NVIDIA leadership transition causes volatility in compute supply expectations
trends.summary: NVIDIA officially announces a CEO transition, with external discussion focused on its effects on chip supply and AI startup funding.
trends.attention_driver: Leadership changes at a core compute supplier have increased market attention to capital allocation and long-term supply stability.

evidence.claim: Supports that NVIDIA has formally announced a CEO transition.

evidence.quote: The Nvidia Machine Is Self-Sustaining – And Was Already Facing A Tougher Future
evidence.claim: Supports that the market is also watching the operational and supply challenges NVIDIA faced before the transition.

evidence.quote: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
evidence.claim: Supports that the leadership change is seen as potentially affecting AI startup funding expectations.

trends.so_what: There is no need to rewrite technical roadmaps on this basis in the near term, but GPU capacity, cloud commitments, and alternative suppliers should be included in quarterly scenario planning. For products sensitive to long-term inference costs, retaining multi-cloud and multi-chip deployment options has become more valuable.

trends.name: External services begin restricting agent proxy access
trends.summary: United Airlines bans agents from booking flights on behalf of users. Meta Muse's agent phone calls also face businesses refusing to answer.
trends.attention_driver: Service providers' control over identity, automated traffic, and liability boundaries is beginning to limit cross-site task automation.

evidence.quote: The airline said it will not allow customers to use AI agents to book flights and manage reservations.
evidence.claim: Supports that airline service providers restrict agent ticket booking and reservation management due to security concerns.

evidence.quote: United Airlines bans AI agents from booking flights on behalf of travelers
evidence.claim: Supports that United Airlines' restrictions on agent ticket booking received independent coverage.

evidence.quote: Meta's AI agent Muse can now call businesses on behalf of paying US subscribers
evidence.claim: Supports a product experiment that lets paid users have Meta Muse contact businesses on their behalf.

trends.so_what: Do not treat web or phone proxy services as stable foundational capabilities. Products should plan for partner interfaces, human takeover, and user review. When measuring task success rates, track service-provider rejection rates separately rather than looking only at model completion rates.

insights.text: Agents are beginning to handle transactions: payments and ad procurement are entering product experiments, and permission design will directly affect whether tasks can launch
Cross-site proxy task success rates are under pressure: service-provider refusals and identity verification will become independent variables in task completion rates
Agent tools continue to expand: protocols, frameworks, and observability are showing new signals at the same time, and products need to reserve integration points

since_last: All 6 trends that ranked in the previous period have exited this period.
